{{Top}}
{{Youmay|basic steel|[[Steel (disambiguation)|another use of the term]]}}
'''Steel''' was a type of material used in building. It was noted for not being aesthetically pleasing, and as such was limited to industrial areas.

==History==
[[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] used this material in its [[Carbon-freezing chamber/Legends|carbon-freezing chambers]], where the [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas mined from [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] would be flash-frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] blocks.

An owner of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] previous to [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], installed a steel safe into the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] section of the vessel.<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>
